name: Malaria
description: Parasitic infection spread by mosquitoes, with fever in cycles of shivering and sweating.

name: Dengue fever
description: Mosquito-borne viral fever with severe body and joint pain.

name: Dengue haemorrhagic fever
description: Severe dengue with bleeding and low platelets. Needs hospital care.

name: Chikungunya
description: Viral fever with intense joint pain that can last weeks.

name: Typhoid
description: Bacterial infection from unsafe food or water, with prolonged fever.

name: Cholera
description: Severe watery diarrhoea that causes dangerous dehydration.

name: Hepatitis A
description: Liver infection from contaminated food or water.

name: Hepatitis B
description: Liver infection spread through blood and body fluids.

name: Hepatitis C
description: Blood-borne liver infection that is often silent for years.

name: Hepatitis E
description: Water-borne liver infection, risky during pregnancy.

name: Tuberculosis
description: Lung infection with a cough lasting more than two weeks. Free testing is available at government centres.

name: COVID-19
description: Viral respiratory illness. Loss of smell or taste is a common clue.

name: Influenza
description: Seasonal flu with sudden fever, aches and cough.

name: Chickenpox
description: Itchy blister-like rash with fever. Spreads easily.

name: Pneumonia
description: Lung infection that can worsen quickly, especially in children and elders.

name: Leptospirosis
description: Spread through floodwater or animal urine. Common after monsoon.

name: Gastroenteritis
description: Stomach infection. Drink ORS and fluids to stay hydrated.

name: Peptic ulcer
description: Sore in the stomach lining, with burning pain between meals.

name: Irritable bowel syndrome
description: Long-term gut condition with cramps and changing stools.

name: Jaundice
description: Yellowing of eyes and skin due to liver or blood problems.

name: Appendicitis
description: Inflamed appendix. Pain moves to the lower right belly.

name: Acid reflux
description: Stomach acid rising into the food pipe.

name: Asthma
description: Airways narrow causing wheeze and breathlessness.

name: COPD
description: Long-term lung disease, often linked to smoking or smoke exposure.

name: Bronchitis
description: Irritated airways causing a lingering cough.

name: Sinusitis
description: Inflamed sinuses with facial pressure and a blocked nose.

name: Allergic rhinitis
description: Allergy causing sneezing, itchy and runny nose.

name: Type 2 diabetes
description: High blood sugar. A simple blood test confirms it.

name: Hypertension
description: High blood pressure, often silent. Check BP regularly.

name: Hypothyroidism
description: Underactive thyroid that slows the body down.

name: Hyperthyroidism
description: Overactive thyroid that speeds the body up.

name: Anaemia
description: Low haemoglobin, commonly from low iron.

name: Migraine
description: Throbbing headache, often with light sensitivity and nausea.

name: Vertigo
description: Spinning sensation, often from inner ear problems.

name: Epilepsy
description: Recurrent seizures. A first seizure needs urgent evaluation.

name: Cervical spondylosis
description: Neck joint wear causing pain and arm tingling.

name: Osteoarthritis
description: Joint wear, with pain and stiffness in knees or hips.

name: Stroke
description: Brain blood flow problem. Every minute counts.

name: Coronary artery disease
description: Narrowed heart arteries causing chest pain on effort.

name: Heart attack
description: Blocked heart artery. Medical emergency.
